# Should Flexi-Cap Funds Still Be Your Core Holding?

As market dynamics evolve, investors are questioning whether flexi-cap funds deserve their place as the default core holding. This video analysis explores the changing role of these funds in a modern portfolio and when it might be time to rethink your strategy.

## The Rise of Active Momentum Funds

Active momentum funds are emerging as a compelling alternative for those looking to capture market trends more aggressively. The discussion examines whether these funds offer a better risk-reward trade-off compared to traditional flexi-cap allocations.

## Key Considerations for Investors

— Evaluate your portfolio's core holdings against current market valuations
— Understand how momentum strategies can complement or replace conventional funds
— Balance active and passive exposure based on your investment horizon
